history.summary: A 958 sqft freehold 2BR in D14 at $1710 PSF, listed ~5% below the project's URA median of $1808 PSF, and only 530m from Paya Lebar interchange (EW/Circle Line). The generous 958 sqft for a 2BR is dual-key/large-format and keeps absolute quantum at $1.64M.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold 2BR at a Paya Lebar interchange (530m, dual MRT lines) with a ~5% discount to project median PSF and a healthy URA resale CAGR of ~4.9% (12 txns). $1.64M sits inside the liquid band; 2BR is the widest tenant/buyer pool. Paya Lebar Central + airbase relocation is a tangible catalyst. The 958 sqft size is large for 2BR (slightly inflates the bedroom count's PSF) but supports own-stay-quality resale demand.

history.summary: Genuinely reasonable package — freehold 2BR at the Paya Lebar dual-line interchange (530m) in the liquid sub-$1.7M band — though the value edge is modest and the appreciation series is thin.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold + interchange location (an MRT-proximity signal that survives the backtest) + widest-pool 2BR + $1.64M in the deepest liquidity band is a sound hold, with Paya Lebar Central + airbase relocation as a real long-horizon catalyst. Tempered to LOW confidence: the ~5% discount is modest, the 4.9% CAGR rests on only 12 txns, and freehold is a level premium not a forward edge.
